decisions.title: Mandatory Idempotency Keys on Checkout
decisions.rationale: Gateway retries caused duplicate charges during network timeouts; every checkout must call verify_idempotency_key.

decisions.title: Integer-Cents Only for Settlement Math
decisions.rationale: Floating-point rounding drifted by 1 cent on high-volume payouts; all fee math must stay in integer cents.

decisions.title: Constant-Time Webhook HMAC Verification
decisions.rationale: Prevents timing side-channel attacks on webhook endpoints.

incidents.title: Double-Charge During Payment Gateway Retry Storm
incidents.root_cause: process_checkout lacked idempotency key deduplication on 504 retries.

incidents.title: Ledger Penny Drift on Batch Payouts
incidents.root_cause: Float multiplication in fee calculation caused 1-cent reconciliation mismatches.

rules.title: Never bypass idempotency check
rules.constraint: All payment entrypoints MUST call verify_idempotency_key before charging.

rules.title: No float currency math
rules.constraint: Monetary amounts MUST remain integer cents.
